title: GitHub Repository Policy Migration 1051 orphan-ledger recovery

phases.objective: Recover an exact missing Migration 1051 ledger without fabricating Apply evidence or replaying SQL under the reconciliation authority, then require a second explicit authority before any idempotent metadata Apply.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed Migration 1051 GitHub Repository Policy Authority Rollout
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Production has complete Migration 1051 metadata and zero missing readback objects but the exact Migration 1051 durable ledger row is absent.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A separately confirmed record-only cycle writes a truthful checksum-bound record_only ledger with sql_applied_by_this_run=false; a later separately confirmed reconciled-Apply cycle may execute the reviewed idempotent metadata migration and create a true apply ledger, while GitHub provider mutation remains unauthorized.
steps: Reuse the existing Migration 1051 workflow authority rather than adding a second workflow.
Fail closed until Migration 225 runtime dependency and the dedicated Governance DB writer readiness both pass.
Run the existing checksum-bound authorization/bootstrap dry-run before record-only reconciliation.
Verify exact Production runtime parity and the reviewed Migration 1051 Git blob.
Require complete semantic metadata and zero missing readback objects before any ledger backfill.
Invoke only the existing migration_ledger_record_apply alias with the exact record-only runner confirmation.
Prove the new ledger is record_only, checksum-bound, preflight pass/0, produced by governed_migration_runner_backfill, and records sql_applied_by_this_run=false.
Require a different typed confirmation before any Migration 1051 SQL Apply.
Recheck Governance writer readiness and exact record-only proof immediately before the reconciled Apply.
Leave APPLY_GITHUB_MAIN_REVIEW_POLICY and all GitHub Ruleset mutation outside this recovery authority.
assertions: Record-only reconciliation cannot run when Migration 1051 metadata is partial or absent.
Record-only reconciliation cannot run with missing schema/readback objects.
Record-only reconciliation cannot run while the Governance DB writer dependency is not ready.
Record-only reconciliation never executes Migration 1051 SQL.
A record-only ledger is never mislabeled as an apply ledger.
The reconciled Apply requires a separate exact confirmation and an exact record-only proof.
The normal Migration 1051 Apply path and its replay guard remain unchanged.
No GitHub provider call, Ruleset mutation, Production deployment, force push, protected-ref mutation, credential payload read, or freeform SQL is authorized by this source change.

phases.objective: Publish bounded operator receipts for record-only reconciliation and reconciled Apply outcomes without exposing secrets.
Exercise Production SHA movement, authorization expiry, duplicate reconciliation, ambiguous transport, and Governance writer regression while preserving fail-closed behavior.
The record-only recovery performs no live GitHub provider canary mutation.
This source change does not authorize Production deployment, DB grant mutation, Migration 1051 execution, or GitHub Ruleset Apply.
